setup: if [ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env.local" ]; then ln -sfn "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env.local" .env.local; else echo 'paseo setup: no .env.local in source checkout, skipping'; fi
npm ci || { echo 'paseo setup: npm ci failed (native build?), retrying without install scripts; better-sqlite3 ships prebuilt binaries'; npm ci --ignore-scripts; }

db-reset.command: DATABASE_URL="$(sed -n 's/^DATABASE_URL=//p' .env.local 2>/dev/null | tail -n1)"; export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-./data/nomly.db}"; npm run seed:dev:load -- --force && echo 'Restart the dev service to pick up the new database.'
